title: English Practice Quiz 0025
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Choose the correct word: ___ going to arrive soon.
questions.explanation: They're is the contraction of they are.

questions.question: They said, 'We have finished.'
questions.explanation: Present perfect commonly shifts to past perfect in reported speech.

questions.question: There ___ two chairs in the room.
questions.explanation: Use are with the plural noun chairs.

questions.question: A synonym of 'begin' is ___.
questions.explanation: Start has the same basic meaning as begin.

questions.question: Read: 'Mina takes the bus at 8 a.m. and reaches work at 8:45.' How does Mina travel?
questions.explanation: The passage clearly says Mina takes the bus.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: She said, 'Please sit down.'
options: She asked me to sit down.
questions.explanation: A request can be reported with asked + object + to-infinitive.

questions.question: I ___ a new notebook yesterday.
questions.explanation: Yesterday signals the past simple. The past form of buy is bought.

questions.question: Choose the opposite of 'polite'.
questions.explanation: Rude is the opposite of polite.
